quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #22
										  					
  

40 Questions • Passing Score 34

questions.question: Traffic signals sometimes show arrows to control turns from specific lanes. A solid yellow arrow:

options.text: Is never used as a traffic signal.
Means the same thing as a yellow traffic light.
Means you can turn in the direction shown by the arrow.
Tells you a green arrow will appear next.

questions.correctAnswerText: Means the same thing as a yellow traffic light.
questions.explanation: A solid yellow arrow means the same as a yellow traffic light. Slow down and get ready to stop when you see it.

questions.question: Your car hits a parked car and you cannot find the owner. You must:

options.text: Leave and do nothing else.
Wait for police to arrive.
Leave a written note with your name, address, and what happened.
Leave and go on your way.

questions.correctAnswerText: Leave a written note with your name, address, and what happened.
questions.explanation: Stop and try to find the owner. If you cannot find them, leave a written note with your name, address, and a description of the accident.

questions.question: Roads freeze quickly when they are:

options.text: Flat.
Curvy.
In the sun.
In the shade.

questions.correctAnswerText: In the shade.
questions.explanation: In cold or wet weather, shaded areas under trees or buildings freeze faster than other parts of the road. These areas also take longer to dry.

questions.question: A five-sided sign shows:

options.text: No passing zones.
School zones.
Speed limits.
Railroad crossings.

questions.correctAnswerText: School zones.
questions.explanation: Five-sided signs mark school zones. Watch carefully for children and pedestrians when driving near a school.

questions.question: When driving to an unfamiliar place, you should:

options.text: Use road signs to find your way.
Plan your trip before you start driving.
Only know roughly where your destination is.
Always take the most direct route.

questions.correctAnswerText: Plan your trip before you start driving.
questions.explanation: Plan your trip in advance before you drive. Check your destination on a map before leaving so you know exactly where you are going.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: The road curves right ahead. Slow down to 35 mph.
A divided highway is starting. Slow down to 35 mph.
Merge ahead. Slow down to 35 mph.
Winding road ahead. Slow down to 35 mph.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves right ahead. Slow down to 35 mph.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road curves right. Slow down to the safe speed shown on the sign, which is 35 mph in this case.

questions.question: You are driving on a highway with two solid yellow lines in the center. You can cross these lines only to:

options.text: Turn left into or out of an alley, private road, or driveway.
Pass other vehicles when there is no oncoming traffic.
Never cross these lines.
Make a U-turn.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn left into or out of an alley, private road, or driveway.
questions.explanation: Double solid yellow lines mean no passing from either direction. You can only cross them to turn left into or out of an alley, private road, or driveway.

questions.question: If your car starts to skid, turn the steering wheel:

options.text: To keep the front wheels straight.
In the direction you want the car to go.
Away from the skid direction.
In any direction. It does not matter.

questions.correctAnswerText: In the direction you want the car to go.
questions.explanation: Turn the steering wheel in the direction you want the car to go. Once the car starts to straighten, turn the wheel back the other way.

questions.question: You see a sign that says "Reduced speed, 35 mph." This means:

options.text: The new 35 mph speed limit starts at this sign.
The new 35 mph speed limit starts at the next speed limit sign.
You have plenty of time to slow down before the zone.
Reduce your speed to 35 mph only in bad weather.

questions.correctAnswerText: The new 35 mph speed limit starts at this sign.
questions.explanation: "Reduced speed" signs tell you to slow down. The new speed limit begins right at the sign.

questions.question: A double solid yellow line down the center of a two-lane road means:

options.text: Traffic goes in opposite directions and you cannot pass.
Traffic goes in opposite directions and you can pass when safe.
Traffic goes in the same direction and you cannot pass.
Traffic goes in the same direction and you can pass when safe.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic goes in opposite directions and you cannot pass.
questions.explanation: Yellow lines separate traffic moving in opposite directions. Solid lines mean no passing is allowed.

questions.question: Stopping distance does NOT depend on:

options.text: Your reaction time.
The time of day.
Your vehicle's brake condition.
Your vehicle's tire condition and type.

questions.correctAnswerText: The time of day.
questions.explanation: Stopping distance depends on your reaction time, weather, visibility, vehicle weight, brake condition, tire condition and type, road conditions, and speed.

questions.question: If your Anti-Lock Braking System (ABS) loses traction on a slippery road, you should:

options.text: Pump the brakes.
Press and hold the brake pedal down.
Press and hold the gas pedal.
Lightly tap the brakes.

questions.correctAnswerText: Press and hold the brake pedal down.
questions.explanation: Press hard on the brake pedal and hold it while steering to safety. The ABS automatically pumps the brakes faster than you could. Releasing pressure or pumping the brakes will turn off the ABS.

questions.question: When a green arrow changes to a solid green light, you:

options.text: Can still turn, but must yield to oncoming traffic.
Cannot turn and must go straight.
Still have the right to turn without yielding.
No longer need to turn in the arrow's direction.

questions.correctAnswerText: Can still turn, but must yield to oncoming traffic.
questions.explanation: When a green arrow becomes a solid green light, you may still turn in that direction. However, you must first yield to pedestrians and oncoming traffic.

questions.question: Drive slower than the posted speed limit when:

options.text: Road conditions are not perfect.
You see a police car.
Entering a highway with other cars.
You are on a four-lane road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Road conditions are not perfect.
questions.explanation: Drive below the speed limit when the road is wet or slippery, when visibility is poor, or when anything else makes conditions unsafe. You can be ticketed for driving too fast for conditions, even at the posted speed limit.

questions.question: What should you adjust first when getting into a car to drive?

options.text: Your seat belt.
The steering wheel.
Your rearview mirror.
Your seat.

questions.correctAnswerText: Your seat.
questions.explanation: First adjust your seat so you are comfortable and can see the road clearly. Then adjust your mirrors and steering wheel based on your seat position.

questions.question: When a transit bus signals to return to the roadway after stopping, you must:

options.text: Honk to alert them.
Move to the left lane.
Yield to the bus.
Speed up to pass it.

questions.correctAnswerText: Yield to the bus.
questions.explanation: You must yield to any bus returning to the roadway after picking up or dropping off passengers. Slow down, change lanes, or stop to let the bus back into traffic safely.

questions.question: This sign is a:

options.text: Service sign.
Regulatory sign.
Warning sign.
Stop sign.

questions.correctAnswerText: Warning sign.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped and yellow with black symbols. They alert drivers to hazards or special situations ahead.

questions.question: When driving in areas where children are playing, expect them to:

options.text: Know when it is safe to cross the street.
Stop at the curb before crossing.
Run into the street without looking.
Only cross with an adult.

questions.correctAnswerText: Run into the street without looking.
questions.explanation: Slow down and be extra careful around children. They may not understand danger and may run in front of you suddenly without looking.

questions.question: To check your blind spot when turning left, glance:

options.text: Over your right shoulder.
At your side mirror.
Over your left shoulder.
At your rearview mirror.

questions.correctAnswerText: Over your left shoulder.
questions.explanation: Glance over your shoulder in the direction you want to move to check your blind spot.

questions.question: Which factor does NOT affect how far your vehicle travels before stopping?

options.text: Steering ability.
Braking distance.
Reaction distance.
Perception time.

questions.correctAnswerText: Steering ability.
questions.explanation: Stopping distance depends on perception time, reaction distance, and braking distance. These change based on speed and road conditions.

questions.question: You must yield to other drivers when:

options.text: Only where a yield sign is posted.
Only when you want to.
They are working in construction zones.
Their car is bigger than yours.

questions.correctAnswerText: They are working in construction zones.
questions.explanation: You must yield to all workers and vehicles in highway construction zones. Drive slowly and carefully through work zones.

questions.question: A flashing yellow light means you should:

options.text: Slow down and proceed with care.
Continue normally through the intersection.
Stop and wait for a green light.
Stop and go when the way is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and proceed with care.
questions.explanation: A flashing yellow light means caution. Slow down, look both ways, and proceed carefully.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: The road turns sharply right, then left.
The road turns sharply left, then right.
The road curves to the left.
Construction ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road turns sharply right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road will turn sharply to the right and then to the left.

questions.question: Which of the following is correct?

options.text: You may turn right at a red light after stopping and yielding to other traffic, unless a sign says otherwise.
You may make a U-turn anywhere unless a sign prohibits it.
You may turn left into any clear lane on a multilane road if no cars are in your way.
All of the above.

questions.correctAnswerText: You may turn right at a red light after stopping and yielding to other traffic, unless a sign says otherwise.
questions.explanation: At a red light, you may turn right after stopping and yielding to pedestrians and oncoming traffic, unless a sign prohibits it. You may also turn left from a one-way street onto another one-way street at a red light after stopping and yielding, unless a sign prohibits it.

questions.question: As a pedestrian, you should:

options.text: Always demand the right-of-way over vehicles in a crosswalk.
Never enter a street or crosswalk when vehicles are near.
Enter a crosswalk anytime because drivers must stop.
Use crosswalks only when convenient.

questions.correctAnswerText: Never enter a street or crosswalk when vehicles are near.
questions.explanation: Do not enter a street or crosswalk when vehicles are approaching. Even though pedestrians have the right-of-way in crosswalks, a nearby vehicle may not have time to stop.

questions.question: When changing lanes, you should:

options.text: Only use your mirrors.
Signal as you move into the next lane.
Signal at least 500 feet before changing lanes on residential streets.
Always check your blind spot.

questions.correctAnswerText: Always check your blind spot.
questions.explanation: Other vehicles hide in your blind spot, so look over your shoulder before changing lanes. Signal 100 feet before turning on residential streets. Signal five seconds before changing lanes on freeways.

questions.question: A flashing yellow light means:

options.text: Stop and check for traffic, then go if clear.
Stop and wait for a green light.
Speed up to cross the intersection quickly.
Slow down and proceed with caution.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and proceed with caution.
questions.explanation: A flashing yellow light means slow down and continue carefully.

questions.question: The driver's left arm and hand extended downward means the driver will:

options.text: Turn left.
Turn right.
Stop.
Start moving.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop.
questions.explanation: When a driver extends their left arm downward, they are signaling that they will stop. Adjust your driving if following this vehicle.

questions.question: A flashing yellow arrow means drivers:

options.text: Should merge into the lane where the arrow points.
Should stop completely.
May turn left after yielding to oncoming traffic and pedestrians.
Have the right-of-way and oncoming traffic will stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: May turn left after yielding to oncoming traffic and pedestrians.
questions.explanation: A flashing yellow arrow allows left turns in the direction of the arrow. However, oncoming traffic has a green light, so you must yield to them and pedestrians.

questions.question: Regulatory signs are usually ____ and must always be obeyed.

options.text: White
Blue
Green
Orange

questions.correctAnswerText: White
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs are usually white with black markings. They control traffic and must always be obeyed.

questions.question: Can you cross a double solid yellow centerline to pass another vehicle?

options.text: Yes.
No.
Yes, if there is no oncoming traffic.
Yes, if the vehicle ahead is driving under the speed limit.

questions.correctAnswerText: No.
questions.explanation: Double solid yellow lines mean no traffic can cross them, except when turning into a driveway or business entrance. You cannot pass over a solid yellow line.

questions.question: When driving on slippery roads, you should:

options.text: Always drive at the maximum speed limit.
Use cruise control to maintain a steady speed.
Reduce your following distance.
Avoid making sudden changes in speed or direction.

questions.correctAnswerText: Avoid making sudden changes in speed or direction.
questions.explanation: Do not make sudden changes in speed or direction on slippery surfaces. Slow down and do not use cruise control.

questions.question: When driving in bad weather, drivers should:

options.text: Speed up to reach their destination faster.
Decrease their following distance.
Increase their following distance.
None of the above.

questions.correctAnswerText: Increase their following distance.
questions.explanation: Increase the distance between your car and the car ahead when driving on wet roads.

questions.question: When passing a car that just parked on the side of the road, you should:

options.text: Expect the driver may open the door as you pass.
Speed up.
Brake hard.
Assume the driver will wait for you to pass before opening the door.

questions.correctAnswerText: Expect the driver may open the door as you pass.
questions.explanation: Expect that a driver may open their door as you approach. Be careful when driving past parked vehicles.

questions.question: Railroad crossings should always be treated as:

options.text: Safe, since trains rarely come.
Dangerous.
Good places to park.
A place where you must stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: Dangerous.
questions.explanation: Always treat railroad crossings as dangerous. Look and listen for trains from both directions. Follow all signs, signals, and flaggers. Never cross until you are sure it is safe.

questions.question: A single broken white line down the center of a two-lane road means:

options.text: Traffic moves in opposite directions and passing is not allowed.
Traffic moves in opposite directions and passing is allowed when safe.
Traffic moves in the same direction and passing is not allowed.
Traffic moves in the same direction and passing is allowed when safe.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic moves in the same direction and passing is allowed when safe.
questions.explanation: White lines separate traffic moving in the same direction. A dashed white line means you can pass when it is safe to do so.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Traffic signal.
Fire station.
T intersection.
Left turn signal.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic signal.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you to an upcoming traffic signal. Be ready for red, yellow, or green lights and cross traffic.

questions.question: When passing on a multilane highway, you should:

options.text: Make sure the passing lane is clear.
Pass only on the right.
Watch for oncoming traffic.
You do not need to use your turn signal.

questions.correctAnswerText: Make sure the passing lane is clear.
questions.explanation: Check that the passing lane is clear before you pass. Always use your turn signal to show you are changing lanes.

questions.question: Blood alcohol content (BAC) depends on all of the following except:

options.text: Your body weight.
How much you drink.
How much time passes between drinks.
How physically fit you are.

questions.correctAnswerText: How physically fit you are.
questions.explanation: Your BAC depends on how much alcohol you drink, the time between drinks, and your weight. Physical fitness does not affect your BAC.

questions.question: When parking uphill on a street with a curb, you should:

options.text: Keep the front wheel straight and set the parking brake.
Turn the front wheels away from the curb.
Turn the front wheels toward the curb.
Turn the back wheels into the curb.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn the front wheels away from the curb.
questions.explanation: Turn your wheels sharply to the left, away from the curb, when parking uphill. If your brakes fail, your car will roll toward the curb instead of into traffic.
